d: The College of Business and Economics is seeking applicants for multiple full-time and part-time faculty openings at the assistant/associate/full professor ranks. Although applicants must possess or soon expect to receive a Ph.D. in a business-related major, candidates with a master’s degree and professional work experience will also be considered for an instructor’s position. Applicants should ideally have relevant experience in teaching undergraduate level courses within the context of a liberal arts education. The positions require energetic and enthusiastic individuals who will assist the College in achieving its mission and vision by engaging students in holistic development. Preference will be given to applicants who can demonstrate simulation usage and a history of high quality teaching outcomes with regard to course delivery, student learning, grading discipline, and student perception and engagement.

d: Company Description Abu Dhabi Vocational Education and Training Institute (ADVETI), established in 2007, is a government initiative under the Abu Dhabi Centre for Technical & Vocational Education and Training (ACTVET). ADVETI operates multiple institutes across the Abu Dhabi Emirate and is licensed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, with full accreditation for its programs. It offers applied certificate and diploma programs in fields such as Business, IT, Environmental Studies, Industrial Technology, Logistics, and Engineering. Programs are developed in consultation with local industry and businesses to ensure graduates are employable and aligned with market needs. ADVETI is also working with the National Qualifications Authority on new vocational programs to further strengthen workforce readiness.

Role Description The Biology Teacher is a full-time, on-site role based in the Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates. The role involves planning and delivering engaging biology lessons that align with ADVETI’s curriculum and vocational focus, using a variety of teaching methods and instructional technologies. The teacher is responsible for assessing student performance, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining accurate records of progress and attainment. Daily tasks include preparing lesson materials, supervising practical activities and lab work, supporting learners with diverse needs, and contributing to curriculum development and quality assurance. The Biology Teacher is also expected to participate in professional development, collaborate with colleagues, and uphold ADVETI’s standards for academic integrity, safety, and student wellbeing.
q: Strong foundation in Biology and related scientific disciplines, with the ability to connect theory to practical and vocational applications.
Demonstrated Teaching experience as a Qualified Teacher, preferably in secondary or vocational education settings.
Proficiency in Lesson Planning, curriculum implementation, and assessment design aligned with institutional standards.
Excellent Communication skills, including clear instructional delivery, feedback to learners, and collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.
Relevant academic qualification in Biology, Science Education, or a closely related field (minimum bachelor’s degree; advanced degrees are an advantage).
Experience with laboratory management, safety procedures, and hands-on science activities in an educational environment.
Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and support diverse learners, including English language learners.
Comfort with educational technology and digital learning tools for lesson delivery, assessment, and student engagement.
